body.name: Observed-law-preserving cap-fibre response-tree gluing handle
body.construction: Given an observed-data law with an admitted sustained-arm full-data extension and \(\gamma\in\mathcal G_H(p_{BT},q)\), \(\mathfrak L\) retains the original joint law of the raw intensive and standard sustained histories. Write \(Z=Y_K^0-Y_k^0\) among standard-arm survivors. For each intensive survivor with realized \((B,T)=(b,t)\) and \(p_{bt}>0\), it first draws \(W=w\) with probability \(\gamma_{btw}/p_{bt}\). Conditional on \(W=w\), it then draws an uncapped switched residual \(\widetilde Z\) from the standard-arm conditional law of \(Z\) given \(S_k^0=1\) and \(\min\{Z,H\}=w\); a zero-probability cap fibre uses any law supported on that fibre. It copies the intensive history through \(k\), keeps the otherwise unobserved switched branch alive through \(K\), adds exactly \(\widetilde Z\) raw events immediately after \(k\), and adds none thereafter. For histories dead by \(k\), it continues the absorbing path. It fills every other unused branch by copying the common prefix to its first treatment divergence and then appending a zero-event legal history. It packages the completed prefix-consistent table as \(U\), using auxiliary draws whose conditional law given the original table does not depend on \(R\), and retains the original \((R,C)\). The sustained factual histories and their joint law with \((R,C)\) are therefore unchanged, so the observed pushforward and the original arm-specific sequential coarsening-at-random and positivity conditions are preserved. Zero-probability \((b,t)\) cells use arbitrary conditional values. The construction neither assumes nor requires independence between censoring and unassigned counterfactual branches.
